title: commcompute splice scheduler + KV lookahead prefetch to reduce TP comm stalls
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Improves multi-GPU tensor-parallel throughput and tail latency by overlapping communication and compute more aggressively. Adds a new CommCompute Splice Scheduler and a KV lookahead prefetch window configurable per-model/workload. No user-facing API changes; runtime flags available for tuning.
